description.en: Paradoxides davidis davidis-inspired fossil dorsal-exoskeleton reconstruction. The technical underside closes the mesh and is not ventral anatomy; thickness and restoration are interpretive, with no complete living-animal claim.
description.zh: 以 Paradoxides davidis davidis 为参考的化石背甲复原。底面仅用于技术封闭，不是腹部解剖；体厚和修复为推断，不主张完整活体复原。
